name: sept-ilp
description: SEPT Interactive Laboratory Platform — schema-first authoring and deterministic rendering of scenario-based laboratory instruction.
author: Majd Aburas

scripts.build:all: node renderer/src/cli.js build content/courses/smrttech-3cc3 --out dist/smrttech-3cc3 --strict --single-file && node renderer/src/cli.js build content/courses/demo-101 --out dist/demo-101 --strict --single-file
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix apps/platform && npm ci --prefix apps/admin && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:platform && npm run test:marker && npm run test:admin
